channel.name: #forgex-launch
channel.purpose: Vendor and customer coordinating the ForgeX community go-live

apex.name: Apex Labs
apex.role: Customer. Software delivery company. Owns ForgeX, the private community for senior engineering leaders.

northstar.name: Northstar
northstar.role: Vendor. Community platform. Implements the ForgeX site, events, emails, and pages.

products.forgex: Apex's member community (events, perspectives, discussions, assessments)
products.northstar_platform: The community platform (chapters, events, SiteBlocks pages, system email, SSO)
products.siteblocks: Northstar's newer page framework. Cannot store native form submissions in this story.
products.pulsemail: Apex marketing automation. Owns most member email journeys.
products.gatesso: Apex SSO. Field executives are supposed to log in through it.
products.agent_connector: Northstar's installable agent connector on the community. Optional flavour, not required for the alarm loop.

glossary.plain: The container that hosts events. Customers keep hearing it as a city chapter. Apex has one HQ chapter they want hidden.
Apex's word for blogs, recaps, playbooks. The platform still files them as forum topics.

glossary.term: system email vs automated email vs newsletter
glossary.plain: Three different admin inboxes. System = transactional, not unsubscribable. Automated = triggered campaigns. Newsletter = manual blast from a chapter.
Marketing wants 'create'. The platform screen always says 'reset'. Same flow, two labels.
Admins clicking Join skip the RSVP form and land on the live room. Members should RSVP.
